Package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport

package com.irurueta.authserver.testsupport
Shared test harness: Testcontainers PostgreSQL support for integration tests, and the comparison of the OpenAPI contracts under apis/ with the documents the applications serve.
  • Class
    Description
    KeyEncryptionTestConfiguration
    Supplies the inputs of the encryption of signing keys at rest to a test context.
    Mailpit
    Describes the Mailpit container the one-time token tests read the e-mail of: the pinned image, its two ports and a factory that builds the container and the client of its HTTP API.
    MailpitClient
    Reads the messages a Mailpit server received through its HTTP API, so a test finds the code or the link the application mailed to a recipient.
    MailpitClient.Message
    A message Mailpit received.
    MailpitTestConfiguration
    Starts a Mailpit container for a Spring test context and points the application's mail sender at it, so the messages the application sends can be read back through MailpitClient.
    OpenApiContract
    Compares an OpenAPI contract under apis/ with the OpenAPI document a running application serves.
    PostgresIT
    Meta-annotation for integration tests backed by a PostgreSQL Testcontainers container.
    PostgresTestConfiguration
    Exposes a PostgreSQL Testcontainers container as a Spring Boot service connection, so the DataSource (and Flyway) of a test context is wired to it automatically.
